name: Onboarding activation analytics (flows, checklists, tours, nudges)
observed_behavior: Dashboard "Free Trial Activation": KPI Total 15,612 users activated (30d), Impact $780K revenue influenced (30d); progress chart; attribution table per intervention (Welcome flow Running 420 users 34.7% $12,493; Product tour Active 288 23.8% $6,742; Setup checklist Running 356 29.4% $9,180; Nudge: Invite team Active 147 12.1% $3,908); nav taxonomy REVIEW/ONBOARDING/AUDIENCE (Goals, Reports, Flows, Checklists, Product tours, Nudges, Message library, Users, Segments); an AI agent panel with artefact-creation prompt chips.
unverified_behavior: Attribution methodology, event pipeline, whether revenue figures are modelled or actual.
business_problem: Teams cannot see which onboarding intervention actually activates users.
jobs_to_be_done: Measure activation per intervention; iterate on the weakest step.
actions: Inspect per-flow attribution; create flows/checklists/tours/nudges/segments (via agent chips or nav)
input_fields: Flow definitions, checklist steps, segment rules
states: Intervention status: Running / Active (semantics to verify before reuse)
data_entities: Flow, Checklist, Tour, Nudge, Segment, ActivationEvent, Attribution
integrations: Product event stream, billing (for revenue attribution)
automation_candidates: Alert when a flow's activation drops week-over-week
edge_cases: Attribution windows overlap between concurrent interventions; dark-mode parity (UIMG-032 proves tokenised theming)
security_privacy: Behavioural data is personal data: consent + retention policy required
benefit_hypothesis: Activation is the highest-leverage SaaS metric; per-intervention attribution directs effort.
acceptance_criteria: Given two running flows, when their windows overlap, then the attribution model used is displayed next to the revenue figure.
test_cases: KPI totals reconcile with the attribution table
Dark/light parity of the same screen
